summary: Design TNFD assessment, governance and disclosure workflows with sector cases and practical process artefacts. Explore the course outline.
lede: Nature-related risk governance training helps ESG, risk and sustainability teams connect nature dependencies and impacts to business decisions. Participants scope assessments with LEAP, use ENCORE to screen dependencies and impacts, and assign governance and escalation responsibilities. They also draft risk-register entries, select decision-useful metrics and build evidence controls to support traceable disclosures despite data limitations.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who shape nature-related assessment, risk oversight or disclosure and need to connect TNFD recommendations to existing business and reporting processes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with ESG, enterprise risk management or sustainability reporting is useful. No ecological modelling, coding or programming is required; the course focuses on governance and process design.
